name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: J.P.Morgan global composite PMI eased to 53.2 in October from 54.3, still above the 51 Watch line
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3 in September, its 45th month of expansion, with manufacturing and services both cooling and business optimism at a five-month low (TrendForce, 4 Nov). The reading remains above the 51 Watch line.
for_you: Slower global activity tends to reach exporters and cyclical employers first. At this level the survey still points to expansion.
why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
